items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Do not clear public exposure or security-sensitive releases. The read-only security baseline covers 59 managed sites, but fleet-doctor is unavailable and operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unevidenced. Risk severity is high for launch and release decisions because material controls are unknown; no active vulnerability is established. Permit only ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves existing compliance boundaries.

Exact security decision: retain the fleet security gate as evidence_needed, keep security-sensitive releases and new public exposure blocked, and continue only the existing read-only evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts. Do not access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue work, or conduct external outreach.
